content.comment_body: I understand it's possible to add a web link in [product_name], but is there an option to include email or text message alerts? I want to send an email or SMS warning when a specific threshold is reached. If that's not possible, can this functionality be achieved in [product_name]?
No, the current [product_name] does not support sending email messages. SMS notifications can only be achieved by using a separate module, such as a [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring options to enable automated notifications (email or SMS) within [product_name] software environments. There is a clear limitation: email notifications are not supported directly, and SMS requires additional hardware modules. This presents a challenge for those who wish to implement notification features solely through software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to configure email and SMS/text notifications directly within [company_name] [product_name] software solutions, preferably without needing extra hardware.
